owner_statement:
D-P4.7-PLAN-AUTH: I, mayank-admin, authorize planning, read-only repository analysis, and official primary-source research only for P4.7 Final Acceptance And Phase 5 Handoff.

The authorized planning scope includes local documentation for a deterministic generated-only end-to-end demonstration from accepted anonymous Phase 3 analytic events through Phase 4 correlation, rule evaluation, proposed-alert creation, mandatory human review, lifecycle transitions, generated reference-candidate workflows, investigation timelines, evidence references, corrections, operational signals, and degradation behavior; exact generated-fixture and replay manifests; cross-subphase contract and chronology validation; evidence indexes with hashes, provenance, traceability, and known limitations; unsupported-claim prevention; generated-only operations and reconstruction runbooks; Phase 5 API, event, command, list/detail, pagination, concurrency, error, and compatibility handoff contracts; Phase 5 operator UI-state inventory covering loading, empty, partial, stale, degraded, denied, conflict, failure, recovery, correction, and accessibility states; consumer compatibility and versioning strategy; acceptance criteria for P4.7-A through P4.7-D; final Phase 4 evidence and acceptance-package design; and explicit Phase 5 planning prerequisites.

Internet research is limited to official primary technical, accessibility, API, event-contract, security, evidence, reliability, and standards sources. Local planning documentation, generated/static planning validation, and one local checkpoint commit without push are authorized.

This does not authorize P4.7 product, test, migration, dependency, model, dataset, inference, camera, media, provider, network, telemetry-backend, workflow-engine, container, Kubernetes, deployment, or runtime implementation; execution of an end-to-end scenario; credentials or secrets; Government, police, private, biometric, vehicle, owner, registration, watchlist, investigation, case, or evidence data; operational alerts, notifications, dispatch, enforcement, or autonomous actions; artifact acquisition; hardware, performance, stress, backup, restore, or recovery execution; Phase 4 final acceptance; Phase 5 planning or implementation; or push, pull, fetch, pull request, merge, release, or other remote Git activity.
